_about: Guide version registry. Cut a release when a FEE changes, when a SERVICE MODEL changes, or when a service is ADDED OR REMOVED — the three things a family was quoted and must keep. Wording and layout changes are not releases: they are built into the current version in place. A Terms of Service or consent-form change is NOT a release either: those forms live in Zanda and freeze their text at issue, so the remedy is to reissue consent to the affected families with a reconsent=1 link, not to cut a new folder. `version` names the folder guide/<version>/, `effective` is the same date in ISO form, `services` lists the pages whose quoted content changed in that release, `tos` is the date of the Terms of Service in force. The build refuses a release that changes a page it does not list. See guide/HANDOVER.md.

versions.note: First versioned release: the five guides as sent to the first families.
